caption:
Wiping up her own spill

The guest tipped her mug and the host said to leave it. She wiped it up anyway, and the table was dry again.

Wiping your own spill takes ten seconds, and the host gets to stay in the conversation.

For whoever wipes up their own spill at a friend's table.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A dark wooden table with a mug lying on its side and a blue puddle spreading beside it. A ink-black block figure with wide white eyes stands at the left and a royal blue one stands at the right. The royal blue one says leave it. I'll get it. The ink-black one says no, I've got it, and a cream cloth slides across the table while the puddle shrinks away and the mug tips back upright. Both turn happy with a pulse. The text stays: me, wiping up my own spill.
